text: Of a grayish rusty colour, and slightly clouded; tho-truncets, rax globular, and slightly heart-shaped; abdomen some-what irregular, and marked with a faint longitudinal cross. 85. A native of Europe, on oak and other trees; abdommed marked with four impressed dots on the back; papilla three.
